hooks.command: IN=$(cat); CMD=$(printf "%s" "$IN" | sed -E "s/.*\"command\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"((\\\\.|[^\"\\\\])*)\".*/\\1/"); printf "%s" "$CMD" | grep -qE "(^|[[:space:]])git([[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$)" || exit 0; printf "%s" "$CMD" | grep -qE -- "(^|[[:space:]])--amend([[:space:]]|$)" && exit 0; GITDIR=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; { [ -f "$GITDIR/MERGE_HEAD" ] || [ -d "$GITDIR/rebase-merge" ] || [ -d "$GITDIR/rebase-apply" ]; } && exit 0; git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qx "JOURNAL.md" && exit 0; echo "BLOCKED: JOURNAL.md not staged. Update JOURNAL.md, then: git add JOURNAL.md" >&2; exit 2
